integrity: The proof uses the source's exact surgery coefficients and linking number to form the integral presentation matrix, then computes its Smith normal form symbolically. The source's determinant \((m+2)^2\) independently agrees with the matrix determinant.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only \(H_1\) of the double branched cover. Cyclic first homology outside \(m\equiv9\pmod{11}\) does not imply that the cover is a lens space or that the branch link is two-bridge.
title: A mod-11 split in the branched-cover homology of the Himeno--Teragaito links
